text:
A divine support who channels Stacia's power to protect and revive allies.

Primary: WIS | Secondary: INT

MP mechanic: MP regenerates natively for spell costs.

Spells:
Stacia's Vitae - instant burst heal
Red Requiem - resurrection
Stacia's Blessing - 30min map-wide all-stats buff
Stacia's Lullaby - sleep CC
Stacia's Hymn - party damage boost, 30s
Stacia's March - party attack speed boost
Stacia's Chorus - bouncing chain heal, 3 targets
Stacia's Cleanse - remove all debuffs from an ally
Void Crescendo - MP-scaling damage, more MP means a bigger hit
Stacia's Veil - 20% damage reduction for the party
Stacia's Armor - AC boost for the party
Grand Finale - 10-second sustained AoE around a targeted ally
Stacia's Bubble - damage-absorb shield on an ally
